About this site

Tarnmose is not a real place. This website was created for the LAS (LLM Access Score) research project, which studies how AI systems reach, read and operate public-sector websites.

Every fact on this site — fees, processing times, office names, eligibility rules — is invented. Nothing here describes any real municipality, government or service, and no national symbols, real place names or real domains are imitated.

The site collects no data, contains no working forms, and is served as static pages. Several near-identical copies of this site exist, each differing in one technical property; they are used to measure how those properties affect automated retrieval.
